findings.title: Placeholder disposition line sits out of source order
findings.detail: BuildDecisions places a real disposition in source-order position 4 (after goal waivers, before spec_assumption rows), but renderDecisions always appends the 'not yet chosen' placeholder after every rendered bullet, including spec_assumption ones. So on a run with spec-assumption decisions but no disposition yet, the placeholder trails the assumptions; once the disposition is actually chosen in a later pass, it will instead appear before them. The task text does not mandate a position for the placeholder, so this is very low-impact, but it is a real positional inconsistency across the two states of the same section.
